sources.quote: GPT-5.5 Pro does not offer a cached input discount.
sources.supports: OpenAI's current official model documentation says GPT-5.5 Pro has no cached input discount.

sources.supports: The current official model page lists $30 input and $180 output per million tokens. It does not document the changed threshold.

notes: OpenAI's current model documentation confirms the $30/$180 base rates and no cached input discount, but it does not state the 200,000- or 272,000-token threshold or when either applied. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint could not be reached, so no historical pricing-page snapshots were available to bracket the threshold change; classification and effective date remain unclear.
